sentences.text:
W.P (C) No.12155 of 2023
Subash Chandra Dash ..... Petitioner
 Mr.Anoop Mishra, Advocate
 Vs.
Collector-cum-District Magistrate, ..... Opposite Parties
Gajapati, At-Paralakhemundi &
Others

Dr. Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice M.S. Raman
 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

The Petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the Opposite Parties not to enter the schedule land without resorting to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting his grievance, the Petitioner has made representation to Opposite Party.1 vide Annexure-3 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.1 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-3, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
